verdict.rationale: Milvus's full-text search accepts raw text and automatically converts it into sparse embeddings at ingest and query time, so the database itself generates embeddings without a separate pipeline. That covers only built-in sparse (BM25-style) vectors. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable model providers or server-side dense embedding generation. Missing for 10: configured model-provider integration (e.g. OpenAI or other embedding APIs), built-in dense embedding generation at ingest and query, independent or hands-on corroboration.
